import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 250015;
    static long[] inv = new long[MAXN];
    static long[] p = new long[MAXN];

    static void CNumberInit(int MAXNUM, long mod) {
        inv[0] = inv[1] = 1;
        p[0] = p[1] = 1;
        for (int i = 2; i <= MAXNUM; i++) {
            inv[i] = (mod - mod / i) * inv[(int)(mod % i)] % mod;
            p[i] = p[i - 1] * i % mod;
        }
        for (int i = 2; i <= MAXNUM; i++) {
            inv[i] = inv[i - 1] * inv[i] % mod;
        }
    }

    static long qmod(long a, long b, long c) {
        long ret = 1;
        for (; b > 0; b >>= 1) {
            if ((b & 1) == 1) ret = ret * a % c;
            a = a * a % c;
        }
        return ret;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        long mod = sc.nextLong();

        CNumberInit((int)n + 5, mod);

        if (n % 2 == 1) {
            System.out.println(qmod(k, n, mod));
        } else {
            ArrayList<Integer> megumi = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 2; i <= n; i += 2) {
                if ((i & n) == i) megumi.add(i);
            }

            long[][] dp = new long[20][MAXN];
            dp[0][(int)n] = 1;
            long ans = 0;

            int lim = Math.min(17, k);
            for (int i = 1; i <= lim; i++) {
                long tmpans = 0;
                for (int idx = 0; idx < megumi.size(); idx++) {
                    int megumiVal = megumi.get(idx);
                    if (dp[i - 1][megumiVal] == 0) continue;
                    int Megumi = megumiVal & (megumiVal - 1);
                    int step = Megumi ^ megumiVal;
                    for (int kk = step; kk <= Megumi; kk += step) {
                        if ((kk & Megumi) == kk) {
                            dp[i][kk] = (dp[i][kk] + dp[i - 1][megumiVal] * p[megumiVal] % mod
                                    * inv[kk] % mod * inv[megumiVal - kk] % mod) % mod;
                        }
                    }
                    tmpans = (tmpans + dp[i - 1][megumiVal]) % mod;
                }
                ans = (ans + tmpans * inv[k - i] % mod) % mod;
            }
            ans = ans * p[k] % mod;
            ans = qmod(k, n, mod) - ans;
            ans = (ans % mod + mod) % mod;
            System.out.println(ans);
        }
        sc.close();
    }
}
